# `aitbc tee launch`

Launch a TEE enclave with a given image.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc tee launch [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--enclave-id` | text | — | yes | The Enclave-id. |
| `--image` | text | — | no | Enclave image identifier |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc tee launch --enclave-id <enclave_id>
```
